title: CKVF Key record
$comment: Non-normative. SPEC.md Community Draft 0.1 Sections 4.4 and 9 are authoritative. These schemas do not replace normative prose.

absolute_key_id.description: unpadded base64url(SHA-256(canonical public key bytes)). Authoritative identifier.

short_key_id.description: Lookup hint only. First 32 bits of the Absolute Key ID digest as uppercase hex with a hyphen. NOT a unique identifier.

family.description: v1.0 families only. MUST NOT be pq, pqc, post-quantum, hybrid, or similar. PQC is algorithm/algorithm_suite under an existing family.

algorithm.description: Primary public-key algorithm. Community registry string (SPEC Appendix A.3).

algorithm_suite.description: Registry string or JSON null. PQC hybrid/composite suites belong here or in algorithm, never as a family.

encoding.description: v1.0 encodings. jwk is reserved and MUST be rejected by v1.0 parsers.

purpose.description: MUST contain at least one value. Duplicate values MUST be rejected.

public_key.description: Unpadded base64url of canonical public key bytes. Appendix C decoded maximum 1 MiB.

private_key.description: Unpadded base64url of native private-key encoding, or JSON null after authorized DELETE_PRIVATE_KEY.

status.description: retired does not delete private_key. Only DELETE_PRIVATE_KEY may set private_key to null.

metadata.description: v1.0 parsers MUST accept an empty object and MUST reject unregistered keys.
